summary: Source-anchored research for Performance KB Articles. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: When a sort lacks a supporting index, a compound index matching the filter and sort can reduce sorting work; compound-index field order matters for query efficiency. (medium confidence)

Use explain execution statistics to compare document examination and index usage before and after a query or index change; a plan label alone is insufficient evidence of improvement. (high confidence)
Use $indexStats to investigate index usage, and hide suspected unnecessary indexes to evaluate query impact before dropping them. (medium confidence)

Start performance troubleshooting by comparing latency with a baseline, finding slow operations in logs or profiler data, and correlating them with resource saturation and recent deployment changes. (high confidence)

An index scan is not universally faster than a collection scan. MongoDB documents this limitation, and experiments on MongoDB 7.0.1 found index-scan preference in cases where collection scans ran faster. (high confidence)

Validate a fix by rerunning representative queries and comparing latency, documents examined, index usage, slow-operation evidence, and resource metrics against the previous baseline. (high confidence)
Diagnose slow operations with profiler or slow-query evidence, then inspect explain plans for the specific query; a generic recommendation to add indexes is insufficient. (high confidence)

Large index builds can interfere with normal operations. MongoDB recommends inspecting long-running operations and considering maintenance windows; SERVER-63095 supplies a historical user report of severe query slowdown during an index build, rather than proof that all builds cause such stalls. (medium confidence)

A collection scan is not automatically a performance defect: for some broad queries it can outperform an index scan, so judge measured work and latency rather than the presence of IXSCAN alone. (high confidence)

$indexStats usage counters are local to the node queried, count user-driven accesses rather than TTL maintenance, and reset on restart, index recreation, or index modification; zero accesses alone does not establish that an index is safe to drop. (medium confidence)

For a support escalation, collect the complete query shape and options, expected versus observed latency, representative executionStats, logs, recent changes, resource metrics, and deployment topology. (low confidence)
Index design must balance read benefits with index maintenance on writes and storage costs; creating indexes for every field or query can degrade overall performance. (high confidence)

The 2024 First Past the Post study found an index-scan preference bias in experiments on MongoDB 7.0.1, including plans exceeding twice the runtime of the best tested alternative; this finding does not establish behavior in later releases. (low confidence) (verified as of 2024-09-25)
The database profiler writes detailed operation data into system.profile and can add performance and disk overhead; assess those costs before production use. (low confidence)

Tencent describes plan drift as a performance regression where the query pattern stays unchanged but the selected index changes. Its examples connect drift to unrepresentative parameter values, changing data distributions, and cache re-evaluation. (low confidence)

Treat cross-database benchmark rankings as workload-specific evidence: the stock-market study evaluated particular hybrid-cloud workloads, while a systematic review found that database performance studies often poorly reflect real use and omit replication detail. (medium confidence)

mongo-perf describes itself as an internal MongoDB microbenchmark tool without support for external users, and warns that its legacy-shell dependency has no guaranteed forward compatibility. A performance KB should check compatibility before proposing it as a general diagnostic tool. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23)

Compare latency with historical baselines or service objectives, correlate spikes with deployment changes and CPU, memory, or disk pressure, and verify fixes by rerunning representative queries. (low confidence)

An index scan can still be inefficient: compare examined keys and documents with returned results. Tencent documents indexed requests scanning roughly 1,500 entries to return only three documents. (high confidence)
